I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

I got that from Pree's own #central-team message from 9 Jun. They wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, after a driver showed up at 7:10. Hollis replied that they'd check the shift template.

I couldn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing in that channel or in the shared files, and I said so in the reply rather than guessing. If the account sheet needs a site ID, someone will have to get it from the account team or Marrow Agrisupply's store ops.

I only used sources Pree can see: #central-team and the public files.
